name: Saaspa.ge

sources.title: Launch pricing — Free / Lite $19 / Pro $39 / Spotlight $149 / Max $29/mo

conditions: Free tier joins the next weekly launch batch — you wait for the launch week
Free tier gives only a 'standard' backlink; a permanent dofollow backlink requires a paid one-time boost AND displaying the Saaspa.ge badge
Ranking on the weekly board is driven by upvotes you drive yourself
requirements: Accepted: software/web services, mobile/desktop apps, browser extensions, dev tools, SaaS, APIs, indie projects and prototypes
Rejected: illegal/harmful products, spam/scams, NSFW, copy-cat clones with no original value
Clear accurate description, high-quality logo and images, working product URL, correct category and tags
preparation: Product name, tagline, full description, working URL
Account credentials; optionally budget for Lite ($19, 48h top-pin + permanent dofollow with badge), Pro ($39, week-long pin + newsletter + social), or Spotlight ($149, 30-day homepage pin, 1/month)
workflow: Fill the product form; choose Free or attach a one-time boost (Lite/Pro/Spotlight)
Free launches wait for the next weekly batch; paid boosts launch this week
Drive upvotes during your launch week to climb the board
watchFor: Badge requirement: permanent dofollow backlinks on all paid tiers say 'with our badge'
Max membership ($29/mo or $199/yr) is a recurring upsell — one-time boosts are repeatable and may be the better buy
Vote manipulation (alt accounts) is explicitly banned and enforced
countsAsLive: Product has a lifetime page under /product/<slug> and appears in the current or past weekly launch batch
